info.name: Brick ERP API
info.description: REST API (`/api`). Import the Brick ERP Local environment, set `baseUrl`, `loginEmail`, and `loginPassword`. Run **Auth → Login** to save `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `tenantId`. Protected routes use Bearer auth from `accessToken`.
